summary: Frontend-only smoke test for the vibrant PageHero redesign across 8 core pages (/wellbeing, /calendar, /pests, /plants, /garden, /recipes, /calm, /journal) + Home regression. All pages render the new colored page-hero band (data-testid=page-hero) with no uncaught JS or console errors. Interactive flows preserved: wellbeing mood selection + save produces the saved flag, calm link routes to /calm, calendar hero contains SeasonsMotif SVG and compare/pdf buttons are present, pests region button renders, plants search + group filters + grid render, garden empty state renders, recipes filter chips render, calm shows locked/paywall for unpaid user, journal unauthenticated shows paywall CTA linking to /#pricing. Home hero and Ask Nadar CTA unchanged.

issues: Very large empty vertical space below the hero and before the footer in the unauthenticated journal view — hero + Become a member CTA sit alone with ~1000px of blank cream before the footer. Consider adding a benefits/preview block or a motif strip below the hero to balance the composition.

action_items: Optional: fill the large empty gap on the unauthenticated /journal page below the hero (benefits list / preview card / motif) for visual balance.
No functional fixes required — redesign ships cleanly.
critical_code_review_comments: PageHero.jsx uses an inline BUTTER_HEX fallback because tailwind doesn't know the butter color — tailwind.config.js was just updated with butter/coral/sky, so this fallback can be replaced with `text-butter` for consistency.
PageHero.jsx — motif container uses hardcoded rgba borders; fine for now but worth tokenizing if more variants are added.
seed_data_creation: Used localStorage patchpot.region=London and pp_consent=rejected to bypass region picker / cookie banner.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Redesign smoke-tested on 2026-01 against the preview URL. All 8 core pages render PageHero with data-testid=page-hero and page-hero-title. No console errors recorded. Only cosmetic feedback is the large empty gap on /journal unauthenticated. Wellbeing mood selection + save works end-to-end (saved_flag appears after click). Calendar hero contains an inline SVG (SeasonsMotif). Garden shows empty state for a fresh visit. Calm shows locked-block/paywall-cta for unpaid user.
